results.title: EHS Management System Implementation
results.description_text: INTRODUCTION Battelle Energy Alliance, LLC (BEA), the Management and Operating Contractor of the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) owned Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is seeking Expressions of Interest from qualified vendors capable of providing a comprehensive Chemical Management Managed Service. INL utilizes an enterprise Chemical Inventory System (CIS) to manage the lifecycle of chemicals. The proposed managed service will operate and administer INL's CIS, ensure accurate inventory control, maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) governance, and coordinate sitewide chemical handling practices. CIS Administration & Data Governance: Maintain CIS data, container records, SDS library, hazard classifications, locations, and user permissions.
